name: Fishing

rounds.endCondition: After the 8th round, or immediately if the ocean stack cannot refill hands (Overfishing)

categories.label: Cards caught per round
categories.labelVi: Số lá bắt được mỗi vòng
categories.hint: 1 point per card caught that round (including the -3 card itself). Enter one value per round.

categories.label: -3 points cards caught
categories.hint: Each caught -3 card is -3 immediately (it still counts 1 as a caught card).

endCondition.description: 8 rounds; Overfishing ends the game early and the highest score still wins.

notes: family: trick-taking. Hand size per round varies (8-13 cards) so caught-card counts differ per round.
